findings.summary: The milestone is created. The green message reads 'The milestone \" \" has been created.' and the list now has an entry with no readable title, only its icons, progress bar and 'Edit / Close / Delete' links. The counter went from 2 Open to 3 Open. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones/new)
findings.expected: The title should be trimmed and a title of only whitespace should be refused like an empty one (the browser already refuses a fully empty field with 'Please fill out this field.'), or at least the milestone should not be created with a blank name.
findings.actual: The milestone is created. The green message reads 'The milestone \" \" has been created.' and the list now has an entry with no readable title, only its icons, progress bar and 'Edit / Close / Delete' links. The counter went from 2 Open to 3 Open.

findings.name: Milestone search treats "%" and "_" as wildcards and returns every milestone
findings.summary: Both characters are passed to the database LIKE pattern unescaped: '%' returns all milestones (15 results) and '_' returns all milestones (14 Open / 2 Closed), although none of the milestone names contains a percent sign or an underscore. The search box shows the character typed and the result area is simply the whole list. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones)
findings.expected: The search matches the literal text typed: '%' finds only milestones whose name contains '%' (none exist, so no results) and '_' finds only milestones whose name contains an underscore (none exist, so no results).
findings.actual: Both characters are passed to the database LIKE pattern unescaped: '%' returns all milestones (15 results) and '_' returns all milestones (14 Open / 2 Closed), although none of the milestone names contains a percent sign or an underscore. The search box shows the character typed and the result area is simply the whole list.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-iohkuh32xzq8xr64ijdg1.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/milestones
Type a single % into the 'Search...' box above the milestone list and press Enter (URL becomes ?state=open&q=%25)
Observe the list: all 15 milestones are listed although none of their names contains a percent sign
Replace the search text with a single underscore _ and press Enter (URL becomes ?state=open&q=_) - again the whole list is shown (14 Open / 2 Closed)

findings.name: Saving a stale edit form in a second tab silently reverts the title and due date saved in the first tab
findings.summary: No warning and no conflict check: tab B saves the whole form, so its stale title agent1-twotab and due date 2026-12-15 overwrite tab A's newer title and due date. The message reads Milestone "agent1-twotab" has been updated and the detail page then shows the old title with the old date Dec 15, 2026 and only tab B's description. Tab A's edit is silently lost. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/milestones/57/edit)
findings.expected: Either the app notices the milestone changed after tab B's form was opened and refuses/warns (e.g. "this milestone has been modified since you opened it"), or tab B's save applies only what tab B changed and keeps tab A's title agent1-twotab-A-title and due date 2026-12-20. In no case should tab A's saved data be silently reverted.
findings.actual: No warning and no conflict check: tab B saves the whole form, so its stale title agent1-twotab and due date 2026-12-15 overwrite tab A's newer title and due date. The message reads Milestone "agent1-twotab" has been updated and the detail page then shows the old title with the old date Dec 15, 2026 and only tab B's description. Tab A's edit is silently lost.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and create a throw-away milestone: open https://5503-iohkuh32xzq8xr64ijdg1.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/milestones/new, title agent1-twotab, due date 2026-12-15, description 'agent1 original description', click Create Milestone (my record is id 57)
Open the edit form https://5503-iohkuh32xzq8xr64ijdg1.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/milestones/57/edit in this tab and in a second tab
In the first tab change the title to agent1-twotab-A-title and the due date to 2026-12-20, click Update Milestone (message: Milestone "agent1-twotab-A-title" has been updated)
In the second tab, which still shows the old title agent1-twotab and date 12/15/2026, change only the description to 'agent1 description edited in tab B' and click Update Milestone
Open https://5503-iohkuh32xzq8xr64ijdg1.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/milestone/57 : the title is agent1-twotab again and the due date Dec 15, 2026 - the first tab's save is gone
